# AI agent beliefs and manager decisions

Private research package for the five-article agent-belief study. It contains the original and altered training materials, the frozen V8 Mistral interactions, the trained Mistral and Qwen adapter lineage, and a portable implementation of the base manager procedure.

**Scope.** This package implements the base prompts and records the responses generated by that procedure. It is not an exact replay of the historical, curated manager-result workbooks. Those workbooks and their run summaries are not included. The repository preparation performed CPU checks only; it did not rerun training or inference.

## Contents

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `DATA` | Five article sets: 25 clean Word versions, 20 genuine tracked-change Word versions, 25 exact training texts, the frozen 20 V8 interactions, questions and source-bound answer keys. |
| `Models` | Pinned base-model manifests, tokenizer/configuration files, adapter configuration and checksum manifests, and 200 manager-instance definitions for each family. Safetensors are distributed through the private release. |
| `Training logs` | Retained per-step training losses, validation/selection records, training examples and lineage. |
| `Parallel Setup` | One-base/multiple-LoRA vLLM server, bounded asynchronous client, token accounting and per-instance timings. |
| `Experiment Codes` | Base-prompt Attempts01–03 for both families, optional unaided recall checks, V8 interaction procedure, training entrypoints and notebooks. |

## Models and assignments

| Family | Base model | Pinned revision | Inference context cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mistral | `mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2` | `b70aa86578567ba3301b21c8a27bea4e8f6d6d61` | 16,384 tokens |
| Qwen | `Qwen/Qwen-7B-Chat` | `218aa3240fd5a5d1e80bb6c47d5d774361913706` | 8,192 tokens |

These are the caps of the configured experiment servers, including the output reservation; they should not be confused with a claim about a model's maximum architectural context.

| Agent or manager | Its five assigned articles | Pair question |
|---|---|---|
| A | Original versions | Participates in every pair |
| B | Magnitude alterations | A–B: magnitude |
| C | Actor alterations | A–C: actor |
| D | Mechanism alterations | A–D: mechanism |
| E | All three alterations | A–E: all three components |

There are five learned manager adapters per family. Each of the 200 instance definitions starts with an empty conversation and references one immutable adapter. An instance is a request context, not a separately trained weight set.

## Run order

1. Clone the private repository. Replace `YOUR PATHWAY` in notebook setup cells with the clone directory, or open the notebooks from within the clone so the root is discovered automatically.
2. Restore the base files and adapter archives using `tools/fetch_models.py`; see `Models/README.md`. Verify their hashes before GPU use.
3. Create the dedicated vLLM environment using `Parallel Setup/README.md`. Start only one model family at a time.
4. Open `Parallel Setup/notebooks/00_Setup.ipynb`, then `Experiment Codes/notebooks/01_Spawn_Agents.ipynb`.
5. Use the frozen V8 conversations as the manager inputs. The separate `02_V8_Interactions.ipynb` notebook exposes the procedure for a new interaction run, including its semantic stopping review.
6. Optionally run the unaided recall check notebook. It asks only a question, preserves every first response and leaves semantic scoring explicit; it does not provide articles or replace answers.
7. Prepare and inspect all exact inputs in `04_Manager_Attempts.ipynb`. Set its execution switch only when ready to generate a new batch. Run Attempts01,02,03 in sequence for the selected family, then switch servers for the other family.

Attempt01 supplies belief differences and the factual question. Attempt02 adds the complete frozen interaction. Attempt03 asks for a verdict rather than an endorsement and follows the permitted categories in its base prompt. Full articles are not supplied in manager calls. Each call places the own-answer field first, but that same-call answer is exposed to all supplied materials; the optional unaided recall check is the separate memory measure.

The base implementation independently queries both participant orientations: 5 articles × 4 pairs × 5 managers × 2 orientations = **200 calls per family per attempt**. Reports place each orientation beside its counterpart and compare choices by actual participant. These are matched repeated evaluations, not 200 independent training replications.

Requests share a frozen GPU base and LoRA tensors. Concurrency is bounded by sequence and token-reservation limits, and the client records GPU memory, exact request/response text, token IDs, input/output counts, queue time, generation time and batch wall time. Parallel per-call durations overlap; summing them is not elapsed runtime.

## Reproducibility and limits

`tests/test_offline.py` checks source binding, participant/answer attribution, all600 base inputs per family, context budgets, stopping logic, recovery and exports without inference. Notebook cells that would train or generate are disabled by default. The port has been checked on CPU; GPU execution of this new repository layout remains a validation step before collecting new experimental data.

Training logs report the checkpoints actually retained. Optimizer states and every intermediate epoch checkpoint were not all retained. Qwen's B checkpoint includes redundant saved tensors; its separate canonical serving export and both hashes are retained. See the training README for the precise lineage and validation selection.

The frozen V8 texts and model outputs are research records. A fluent explanation is not itself a correctness measure. Source-based truth, a manager's assigned belief and agreement between participants are separate quantities.

Machine-specific paths are masked with `YOUR PATHWAY`; internal references are relative. No VM hostname, cloud project identifier, credentials or historical run-summary files are included. Model licenses and third-party notices remain applicable. See `Models/README.md` and the upstream model cards.
